scope: Local application and test changes; disposable PostgreSQL 17 only. No production, R2, server, or external services.
finding: A delayed storage abort could overwrite a successfully completed original as ABANDONED after the upload row had already become READY.
regression: RED before fix: the Studio abort endpoint returned 200 after completion had won. GREEN after fix: abort returns 409 UPLOAD_NOT_OPEN; row remains READY, activeOriginalId remains v2, and one encode job exists.
implementation: Abort closes the row using updateMany conditional on id, videoId, and status UPLOADING. A zero-row compare-and-set is reported as 409. NoSuchUpload is reconciled through the same status compare-and-set.

verification.postgres_original_upload_suite: 5/5 PASS on disposable PostgreSQL 17 after 84 migrations

remaining: R2 provider behavior and independent review remain outstanding; K15 stays open.
